# #3658: Patch: follow-up to #3644 from the after-merge spot-check
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

<!-- jackioh-bot:spot-check-follow-up #3644 -->
The after-merge spot-check of #3644 ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/42878659477)) found 1 blocking problem(s) in the change as it merged (`62b8ed2e3d69`). `claude-8` (claude, `opus`, strong) reviewed it. #3644 stays merged: nothing is reverted, and this issue fixes what it found in a change of its own, from `main`.

## What to fix

- [ ] `crates/run/src/lib.rs:636`: `RunAction::Heal` was renamed to `GainMaxHp` with no serde alias, so a run kept on the device that rested at a campfire before this change can no longer be read: it is deleted on load without a notice, and its extractions are lost instead of banked as R3496000 promises.
  Evidence: Before this change the campfire screen sent `{ type: "heal" }` (old TileScreens.tsx), and `apps/web/src/dungeon/store.ts` keeps a run as its `RunFile` log. `RunAction` is `#[serde(tag = "type", rename_all = "camelCase")]` with no `alias = "heal"` on `GainMaxHp`, so `crates/wasm/core/src/lib.rs:237` `parse("runFold: the file", …)` returns Err. The wasm binding turns that into a thrown `JsError`, and `apps/web/src/wasm/index.ts:137` `call` rethrows it. `foldKept` (store.ts:287-296) catches the throw and returns null, and store.ts:385-388 then runs `removeStored(DUNGEON_RUN_KEY)` ("dropped alone… never settled"), skipping `settleUnfoldable`, which banks extractions and shows the notice. The issue's 'Kept runs' paragraph says such a run ends 'with a notice and keeps its extractions'. The PR's no-alias decision covers only `RunEventOption.hp`, never this action. Fix: add `#[serde(alias = "heal")]` to `GainMaxHp` (an old rest folds as today's rest), with a test that a `RunFile` JSON whose log holds `{"type":"heal"}` deserializes and folds; or route a parse failure of a kept file to the `"gone"` path.

## Done when

- Each finding above is fixed where it points, or answered with the evidence that it does not hold.
- Every check is green, with no test skipped, ignored or weakened to get there (CLAUDE.md rule 12).

---

## Plan

_Written by `muse` (muse, `muse-spark-1.3-contributor`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/42880428699)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

`RunAction::GainMaxHp` in `crates/run/src/lib.rs` gains `#[serde(alias = "heal")]` so a kept `RunFile` whose log holds `{"type":"heal"}` (written before #3644, when the campfire screen sent `{ type: "heal" }`) deserializes and folds as today's rest. A new test in `crates/run/src/tests.rs` proves an old-shape file deserializes and folds to the same state. The silent-drop path in `apps/web/src/dungeon/store.ts` is left alone.

## Files to touch

| File | New / change | What changes |
|---|---|---|
| `crates/run/src/lib.rs` | change | One attribute on the `GainMaxHp` variant of `RunAction` (about line 635): `#[serde(alias = "heal")]`, with its comment naming the old name |
| `crates/run/src/tests.rs` | change | One new test, `an_old_heal_rest_reads_as_gain_max_hp_and_folds`, after `a_run_played_to_the_end_wins_and_its_file_folds_back_to_the_same_state` (line 260) |

Must not touch: `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`, `apps/web/src/dungeon/store.ts` (the reroute alternative is rejected, see step 1), `spec/` and `spec/pending/3584.md` (its "no serde alias" line covers only `RunEventOption.hp`, which is content-side under versioned content, not the kept log), `apps/web/src/wire/generated/*` (hand-editing generated files is forbidden; the alias must leave them byte-identical).

Governing spec: `spec/15-dungeon-run.md` §15.8 (campfire rest adds `RUN_CAMPFIRE_MAX_HP`); context rulings `R3584000`, `R3584001`, `R3496000` (kept-run fold/settle contract), all unchanged. No new ruling: this is a compatibility fix, not a rules decision the spec leaves open.

## Steps

1. Re-read the evidence and reject the alternative. Read `crates/run/src/lib.rs:579-647` (`RunAction`), `crates/wasm/core/src/lib.rs:235-243` (`run_fold`'s `parse("runFold: the file", …)`), and `apps/web/src/dungeon/store.ts:282-296,374-403` (`foldKept`, `loadCore`). Confirm the chain in the issue holds. Do the alias fix, not the store reroute: `foldKept`'s `null` path exists so a transient wasm failure never mints a history record (`store.ts:273-275`, `R3496000` note); routing parse throws to `"gone"` would settle a run as lost on a transient error. Record this rejection in the PR description.
2. Add the alias in `crates/run/src/lib.rs`. On the `GainMaxHp` variant of `RunAction` (inside the enum tagged `#[serde(tag = "type", rename_all = "camelCase", rename_all_fields = "camelCase")]`), add exactly:
   ```rust
   /// A campfire's rest: `RUN_CAMPFIRE_MAX_HP` more max HP, for the rest of the run.
   /// Spelled `heal` in logs kept before #3644, which reads as it.
   #[serde(alias = "heal")]
   GainMaxHp,
   ```
   The alias string is lowercase `"heal"`: the old variant was `Heal`, camelCased to `heal`. Copy the variant-level alias pattern from `crates/engine/src/wire/catalog_types.rs:664` (`#[serde(alias = "Magnetic")]` on `KeywordKind::Equip`). The alias is deserialization-only: new files still serialize as `{"type":"gainMaxHp"}`, so `apps/web/src/wire/generated/RunAction.ts` must not change.
3. Add the test in `crates/run/src/tests.rs`, directly after `a_run_played_to_the_end_wins_and_its_file_folds_back_to_the_same_state`. Name it exactly `an_old_heal_rest_reads_as_gain_max_hp_and_folds`. Use only the file's existing helpers (`content()`, `setup()`, `play_out()`) and imports (`super::*`, hence `RunFile`, `RunAction`, `RunUnlocks`, `run_fold` are in scope). Body:
   ```rust
   #[test]
   fn an_old_heal_rest_reads_as_gain_max_hp_and_folds() {
       let content = content();
       let setup = setup(&content);
       let (end, log) = play_out(&content, &setup);
       assert!(log.iter().any(|a| *a == RunAction::GainMaxHp));
       // New writes keep the new name: the alias reads only.
       assert_eq!(
           serde_json::to_value(RunAction::GainMaxHp).unwrap(),
           serde_json::json!({ "type": "gainMaxHp" })
       );
       let file = RunFile { setup, unlocks: RunUnlocks::default(), log };
       // What the device kept before #3644: the campfire screen sent `{ type: "heal" }`.
       let json = serde_json::to_string(&file).unwrap().replace("\"gainMaxHp\"", "\"heal\"");
       let back: RunFile = serde_json::from_str(&json).unwrap();
       assert!(back.log.iter().any(|a| *a == RunAction::GainMaxHp));
       assert_eq!(run_fold(&back, &content), Ok(end));
   }
   ```
   The quoted replace (`"gainMaxHp"` with quotes) touches only the action tags. `play_out` ends `Won` and rests at every campfire, so the replaced file exercises the alias on a real kept log.
4. Run the checks in **Tests** below, in order. If `git status --porcelain -- apps/web/src/wire` shows any diff after the `--features ts` run, the alias leaked into codegen: stop and report instead of editing generated files.

## Tests

- New test: `crates/run/src/tests.rs`, `an_old_heal_rest_reads_as_gain_max_hp_and_folds`: asserts `GainMaxHp` serializes as `gainMaxHp`, a `RunFile` JSON whose log holds `{"type":"heal"}` deserializes with a `GainMaxHp` entry, and `run_fold` of it equals the played-out end state. It fails without the alias (`from_str` errors on unknown variant `heal`).
- Commands:
  - `cargo test -p jackioh-run an_old_heal_rest_reads_as_gain_max_hp_and_folds`
  - `cargo test -p jackioh-run` (whole crate, no regressions)
  - `cargo test -p jackioh-run --features ts an_old_heal_rest_reads_as_gain_max_hp_and_folds && test -z "$(git status --porcelain -- apps/web/src/wire)"` (codegen unchanged)
  - `cargo fmt --check`
  - `cargo clippy -p jackioh-run --all-targets -- -D warnings`
- No web test file is touched, so no `pnpm --dir apps/web test` run is needed. No ruling is added or cited, so `cargo jackioh spec check` is not needed.

## Done when

- [ ] `GainMaxHp` carries `#[serde(alias = "heal")]` and serializes as `gainMaxHp`
- [ ] The new test passes and fails with the alias removed (verify by stashing the one attribute, running the test, restoring)
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-run`, `cargo fmt --check`, and `cargo clippy -p jackioh-run --all-targets -- -D warnings` are green
- [ ] `apps/web/src/wire/` is byte-identical after the `--features ts` run
- [ ] The PR description records the rejected store-reroute alternative and why

## Risks

- Determinism/replay: the alias maps to the identical `GainMaxHp` variant, so an old rest folds exactly as today's rest; the test's `run_fold == Ok(end)` assertion guards this. No random pools or new branches are involved.
- Hidden information / client rules: untouched; the client still sends `gainMaxHp` and enforces nothing.
- Purity (CLAUDE.md rule 4): one serde attribute, no new dependency or code path; `clippy.toml` unaffected.
- Scope creep: `RunEventOption.hp` → `max_hp` intentionally keeps no alias (pending/3584.md); event options live in versioned content, not kept logs. Do not add one.

## Open questions

None. The issue settles the fix (alias) and its location; no person-only decision is needed.
